evidence.says: Heading Paisner, Daniel; variant Dan Paisner. Sources include America is my neighborhood (1987) and The ball (1999). The 2006 Contemporary Authors citation describes a journalist, author and Long Island University adjunct professor, born circa 1960. A 2022 Wikipedia citation gives 1959. The structured birth year is 1952, conflicting with both notes. LC links Q38019135, VIAF 49359449, ISNI 0000000107810493 and GND 1199013331.

Daniel Paisner; occupation writer; English Wikipedia sitelink Daniel Paisner. P244 is n86129168, P214 is 49359449, P213 is 0000000107810493 and P227 is 1199013331, all matching LC. P569 gives 1960, while the English description says born 1959.
German National Library authority names Daniel Paisner, gives birth year 1960, and describes a journalist and author who was an adjunct professor at Long Island University.

BnF identifies Paisner, Daniel through Sur la ligne (2009), a collaboration with Serena Williams, and gives matching ISNI 0000 0001 0781 0493. Its birth field is only 19.., so it does not resolve the year.

The author describes his work as a journalist, author, ghostwriter and host of As Told To, and lists collaborations with Serena Williams and the novels A Single Happened Thing and Balloon Dog. This supports the professional identity; the page supplies no birth year.
